description: Εθνικό Πλαίσιο Χωροταξικού Σχεδιασμού & Αειφόρου Ανάπτυξης για τις ανανεώσιμες πηγές ενέργειας (Α.Π.Ε.) is a dataset listed in data.gov.gr, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Υπουργείο Περιβάλλοντος και Ενέργειας. a) Decisão que aprova o Enquadramento Especial e a Avaliação Estratégica do Impacto Ambiental (Jornal Oficial, Série II, n.o 2464/03.12.2008), b) Mapas e diagramas: zonas eólicas prioritárias (WPA), hidrodinâmica disponível, zonas de parques eólicos SE e D Ática, c) estudo de apoio (estudo-quadro especial FER, fase A), d) avaliação estratégica do impacto ambiental (AEIE) e) ... Coverage: Greece. The portal shows the English title as "Национална рамка за пространствено планиране и устойчиво развитие за възобновяеми енергийни източници (ВЕИ)" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Υπουργείο Περιβάλλοντος και Ενέργειας. Its keywords include repository.data.gov.gr, Χωροταξία, Ανανεώσιμεσ πηγέσ ενέργειασ, Από μετάπτωση. The listing shows 1 download or service links in ZIP. The listing shows 2026-02-23 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-gov-gr.
